briefdescription.para: Capture one stream's VSC SDP colorimetry word (DB16..DB18) at packet-arrival time.

detaileddescription.para: YUV420/BPC/colorimetry are carried only in the VSC SDP; reading the per-stream colour-format register here (right when that stream's EXT_PKT fires) avoids the one-shot latch race in GetMsa that made streams 3/4 miss YUV420. The value is stored sticky and consumed by DetectResolution and the TX forwarder. Each stream reads its own register, so there is no shared-FIFO aliasing between streams.

parameterdescription.para: is the 1-based RX stream id (XDP_RX_STREAM_ID1..4).

briefdescription.para: Per-stream EXT_PKT (SDP) callbacks for streams 2, 3 and 4.

detaileddescription.para: The driver dispatches the per-stream EXT_PKT interrupts (INTERRUPT_CAUSE_1) to these slots, so each one knows exactly which stream's VSC SDP just arrived.
